notes: UI-audit batch 2 (v1.11.42 — audit §16 items 11–20): (11) Analytics trend charts show an honest empty state («هنوز باکسی انجام نشده») when fewer than 2 data points, and the default trend range is 4 weeks instead of the current week; (12) exam readiness shows «—» instead of «۰٪» when no budget question count has been entered; (13) assignment chapter/section dropdowns are disabled with «اول کتاب را انتخاب کن» until a book is chosen; (14) Analytics filters collapse behind a «فیلترها ▸» toggle and active filters show as removable chips above the KPIs; (15) KPI grid is 6 cards in a row with one-line subtitles (shortened planned-hours note); (16) testbook book cards show «حل‌شده از مجموع» using the known book total (حسابان 3489 / شیمی 3000) when no per-section total is entered, and chapter cards are more compact; (17) Google Calendar connect is 3 numbered steps (۱. اتصال گوگل، ۲. ICS، ۳. دستی) with a per-step status pill, and secondary buttons live in a «بیشتر» menu; (18) stronger active-tab indicator (4px accent bar + bold + aria-current) and tabs renamed «برنامه ماهانه» / «همگام‌سازی گوگل»; (19) planned-bar fill contrast raised (dark #3a3a55, light #9aa3b2); (20) backup version dates display in Jalali (incl. settings update info) and file inputs are styled Persian pickers (no «Choose File / No file chosen»). 12 new i18n keys (1226/1226).
